name: Colonel Bryd
description: A Drannith officer relieved of command at the main gate.

description_citations.text: "Brin and Roland". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina confronts Colonel Bryd, assumes command, and the gates open so Zeph and Barrow enter Drannith.
timeline.quote: After Jirina assumed command, the gates were opened, and Zeph entered the city without incident

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland enter Drannith with Jirina's group after Colonel Bryd is relieved of command.
timeline.quote: Once Bryd was relieved of command, Brin and Roland were accepted into the city

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina returns to Drannith, deposes Colonel Bryd and takes command with Vivien and the bonders.
timeline.quote: assuming de facto command after successfully deposing Colonel Bryd

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina leads Drannith's survivors along the terror road toward Lavabrink while Colonel Bryd urges sending soldiers ahead.
timeline.quote: Perhaps it would be wise to send a detachment of soldiers ahead, to prepare Lavabrink for our arrival.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
timeline.quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina deliberately changes the column's course to a path that does not lead to Lavabrink, silencing Haldan's warning about whose territory it is.
timeline.quote: If you want to make it to nightfall alive, you'll say nothing.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina takes over command from Colonel Bryd.
timeline.quote: Jirina successfully took over command of Drannith's forces from Colonel Bryd

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
